holdout.rationale: Reserve independent views to measure subject loss.

mask_scale.rationale: Measured cannon projected radius is about 2.7 pixels.

depth_alpha_min.rationale: Opaque gate matches clean_export dense center.

depth_scale.rationale: Coarse cells bias toward abstention and keeping.

depth_abs.rationale: Absolute floor relative to robust extent.

depth_extent.rationale: Three scale axes of reach behind the surface.

depth_fill.rationale: One 3x3 minimum pass closes thin-surface holes.

min_views.rationale: Provisional: tune against held-out recall on cannon and oak.

min_inside.rationale: Require at least one inside judgement.

inside_fraction.rationale: Provisional: tune against held-out recall on cannon and oak.

outlier_cell_fraction.rationale: Uniform-grid cell relative to robust extent.

outlier_min_neighbours.rationale: Provisional: tune against held-out recall on cannon and oak; support includes self.

sheet_distance.rationale: Fixed normalized review distance, independent of solve camera distance.

near_fraction.rationale: Positive-depth floor relative to robust extent.

grid_tolerance.rationale: Maximum difference in horizontal and vertical grid scale.

min_coverage.rationale: Same near-empty mask exclusion as make_scene_payload.

max_coverage.rationale: Same fully opaque mask exclusion as make_scene_payload.
